hints.title: Longest Path Structure
hints.text: The longest path in any subtree either passes through the subtree root or lies entirely within one of its child subtrees.

hints.title: Top Two Child Depths
hints.text: For each node, compute the heights of all children and track the top two largest depths: max1 and max2.

hints.title: Global Diameter Update
hints.text: Update the global diameter with max1 + max2, and return max1 + 1 to the parent caller.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Visits each node once in linear time with recursion stack bounded by tree height H.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing distances between all pairs of nodes takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bottom-up DFS aggregates top two subtree depths in a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Post-order tree traversal tracking two largest child branch heights.

solutions.approach: JavaScript Top Two Child Height DFS
